notes.title: Working on Train Manager
notes.content:
I have read all of the reviews and I would like to announce that I will be trying to improve the following:
  Make the Game run better.
  Implement a different crash animation.
  Making ui less clicky.


I am sorry when some people did not expect what they wanted. I am doing this in my free time so it may take a while not to mention that this is my first game.
